name: After § 43
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 43b. Calls, therefore, for a radical overhaul of the common agricultural policy (CAP) in the next MFF, to put an end to the current unfair distribution of payments between countries, producers and types of production; to improve salaries for farmers with small and medium-sized holdings; to devolve responsibility for market and production regulation mechanisms to the Member States, guaranteeing the right to produce and fair production prices for each country; to push for food security and sovereignty in each country; to respect the particular characteristics of each country and region, with a view to regionalisation of the CAP; to make greater use of capping and modulation; and to allow a principle to be established whereby national produce is prioritised over imports from EU or non-EU countries;
